description: This is a Java test class for Android that tests file symlink functionality across different Android versions, specifically focusing on Android's symlink handling and storage directories.

classes.name: FileCompatTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing Android file symlink operations and storage directory selection.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, copies asset to directory, and sets up source and destination files.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up by deleting test files after tests run.

methods.name: testSymlinkRuntime
methods.description: Tests creating a symlink using runtime method.

methods.name: testSymlinkLibcore
methods.description: Tests creating a symlink using libcore method, only on API >= 19.

methods.name: testSymlinkOs
methods.description: Tests creating a symlink using OS method, only on API >= 21.

methods.name: getWriteableDir
methods.description: Selects a writable directory from a list of storage options.
